questions.questionText: In The Goldbergs, what is Beverly Goldberg's signature parenting style often described as?
What is Steve Urkel's catchphrase when he breaks something in Family Matters?
questions.funFact: Jaleel White was only supposed to appear in one episode. The audience reaction was so positive that Steve Urkel became the show's main character.

questions.questionText: What is Carl Winslow's occupation in Family Matters?
questions.funFact: Reginald VelJohnson also played a cop in Die Hard. He's one of the few actors typecast as law enforcement across multiple iconic roles.

questions.questionText: What is the name of Steve Urkel's suave alter-ego in Family Matters?
questions.funFact: Jaleel White played three different characters on the show: Steve Urkel, Stefan Urquelle, and Steve's female cousin Myrtle Urkel.

questions.questionText: What kind of car does Steve Urkel drive in Family Matters?
questions.funFact: The BMW Isetta was a 1950s 'bubble car' with a single front-opening door. It became as iconic to the show as Urkel's suspenders.

questions.questionText: In what city is Family Matters set?
questions.funFact: Family Matters was a spin-off of Perfect Strangers. Harriette Winslow was originally an elevator operator on that show.

questions.questionText: What happened to the youngest Winslow daughter Judy in Family Matters?
options: She was quietly written out after season 4
She moved to live with relatives
questions.funFact: Judy Winslow simply vanished from the show with no explanation. Fans jokingly say she 'went upstairs and never came back down.'

questions.questionText: In Step by Step, where do Frank and Carol meet and impulsively get married?
questions.funFact: The whirlwind Jamaica wedding was the show's entire premise — two strangers marry on vacation, then discover they each have three kids.

questions.questionText: What is Frank Lambert's occupation in Step by Step?
questions.funFact: Patrick Duffy was best known as Bobby Ewing on Dallas before playing Frank. Step by Step was a major career shift from primetime drama to family comedy.

questions.questionText: Who is the laid-back, van-dwelling nephew in Step by Step?
questions.funFact: Cody lived in a van in the Lamberts' driveway and became the show's breakout character, much like Urkel did on Family Matters.

questions.questionText: In what state is Step by Step set?
questions.funFact: The show is set in Port Washington, Wisconsin, but the opening credits were filmed at Six Flags Magic Mountain in California.

questions.questionText: Who played Carol Foster-Lambert on Step by Step?
questions.funFact: Suzanne Somers was already famous from Three's Company. Step by Step gave her a second major sitcom run over a decade later.

questions.questionText: What ABC programming block did Step by Step originally air on?
questions.funFact: TGIF was ABC's legendary Friday night lineup that also included Full House, Family Matters, and Boy Meets World.

questions.questionText: What is Reverend Eric Camden's profession in 7th Heaven?
questions.funFact: Stephen Collins was offered the role just two days before the pilot was filmed. He never even auditioned for it.

questions.questionText: How many children do Eric and Annie Camden have in 7th Heaven?
questions.funFact: The show's title '7th Heaven' is a play on the seven Camden children. The twins Sam and David weren't introduced until season 4.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the Camden family dog in 7th Heaven?
questions.funFact: Happy the dog was credited as 'playing herself' throughout the series — one of TV's most famous animal cast members.

questions.questionText: In what fictional California town is 7th Heaven set?
questions.funFact: 7th Heaven ran for 11 seasons, making it the longest-running series ever produced by Aaron Spelling.

questions.questionText: Which Camden daughter was played by Jessica Biel in 7th Heaven?
questions.funFact: Jessica Biel wanted off the show so badly to pursue a film career that she posed in a magazine shoot hoping to get fired. It didn't work.

questions.questionText: Which Camden child followed in their father's footsteps and became a minister?
questions.funFact: Lucy married Kevin Kinkirk and had a daughter named Savannah while serving as associate pastor at her father's church.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the restaurant Roseanne and Jackie open together?
questions.funFact: The Lanford Lunch Box's specialty was 'loose-meat sandwiches' — a real Midwest dish also known as a Maid-Rite.

questions.questionText: In what fictional Illinois town do the Conners live in Roseanne?
questions.funFact: Lanford was based on the real city of Elgin, Illinois. The Conners' address was 714 Delaware Street.

questions.questionText: Who plays Dan Conner on Roseanne?
questions.funFact: John Goodman has said Dan Conner is his favorite role of his entire career, including all his film work.

questions.questionText: What is Dan Conner's primary occupation in Roseanne?
questions.funFact: Dan's sporadic employment was a deliberate choice to portray realistic blue-collar life. He also briefly ran a motorcycle shop that failed.

questions.questionText: What was Roseanne's first job at the start of the series?
questions.funFact: Roseanne cycled through more jobs than almost any sitcom character — factory worker, telemarketer, bartender, fast-food cashier, and diner owner.

questions.questionText: Which Conner daughter was played by Sara Gilbert on Roseanne?
questions.funFact: Sara Gilbert later created and hosted The Talk on CBS. She was only 13 when Roseanne premiered.

questions.questionText: What was Jackie Harris's career before becoming a trucker on Roseanne?
questions.funFact: Laurie Metcalf appeared in 219 of the show's 222 episodes. She won three consecutive Emmys for playing Jackie.

questions.questionText: What was the original working title of Roseanne before it aired?
questions.funFact: The show was almost called 'Life and Stuff.' The network changed it to 'Roseanne' to capitalize on Roseanne Barr's stand-up fame.

questions.questionText: What is Malcolm's IQ in Malcolm in the Middle?
questions.funFact: Despite his genius IQ, Malcolm's family is so chaotic that his intelligence is constantly undermined by his environment.

questions.questionText: Who plays the father Hal in Malcolm in the Middle?
questions.funFact: Bryan Cranston went straight from playing the goofy Hal to playing Walter White on Breaking Bad — one of TV's most dramatic career pivots.

questions.questionText: What is unique about how Malcolm addresses the audience in Malcolm in the Middle?
options: He breaks the fourth wall and talks directly to the camera
He writes in a journal shown on screen
He talks to an imaginary friend
questions.funFact: The fourth-wall breaks were inspired by Ferris Bueller's Day Off. Frankie Muniz was only 13 when the show premiered.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the oldest brother who is away at military school in Malcolm in the Middle?
questions.funFact: Francis was sent to military school before the series began. His storylines there ran as a parallel show-within-the-show.

questions.questionText: What is the family's last name in Malcolm in the Middle?
options: It was intentionally kept a mystery
questions.funFact: The name 'Wilkerson' appeared on Francis's nametag in the pilot but was never used again. The creator removed it to avoid any ethnic labeling.

questions.questionText: Who plays the domineering mother Lois in Malcolm in the Middle?
questions.funFact: Jane Kaczmarek was nominated for seven consecutive Emmy Awards for playing Lois but never won — one of TV's longest losing streaks.

questions.questionText: What city did Will Smith move from to live with his aunt and uncle in Fresh Prince?
questions.funFact: The theme song was co-written by Will Smith and DJ Jazzy Jeff. It became one of the most recognizable TV intros of all time.

questions.questionText: What song does Carlton Banks famously dance to in Fresh Prince of Bel-Air?
options: It's Not Unusual by Tom Jones
Jump Around by House of Pain
Twist and Shout by The Beatles
questions.funFact: Alfonso Ribeiro based 'The Carlton' on Courteney Cox dancing in Bruce Springsteen's 'Dancing in the Dark' video and Eddie Murphy's comedy.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the Banks family butler in Fresh Prince of Bel-Air?
questions.funFact: Geoffrey's dry sarcasm made him a fan favorite. Joseph Marcell improvised many of his best one-liners.

questions.questionText: What is Uncle Phil's profession in Fresh Prince of Bel-Air?
questions.funFact: James Avery brought such gravitas to Uncle Phil that his pool-hall scene — revealing he grew up in the same rough neighborhood as Will — is considered the show's best dramatic moment.

questions.questionText: Who drove the cab in the Fresh Prince of Bel-Air opening credits?
questions.funFact: Quincy Jones was an executive producer on the show. His brief cameo as the cab driver went unnoticed by most viewers for years.

questions.questionText: Why was Aunt Vivian recast after season 3 of Fresh Prince?
options: Janet Hubert left due to conflicts with the show
questions.funFact: The feud between Janet Hubert and Will Smith lasted nearly 30 years. They finally reconciled on camera during the 2020 reunion special.

questions.questionText: What is Ray Barone's job in Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: The show was based on Ray Romano's real life. His actual brother is a police officer, just like Robert Barone on the show.

questions.questionText: What is the relationship between Ray and Robert Barone in Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: On the show Robert is 4 years older than Ray, but in real life Ray Romano is actually older than Brad Garrett.

questions.questionText: Where do Frank and Marie Barone live in relation to Ray in Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: The across-the-street setup was based on Ray Romano's real life — his parents actually lived that close to him on Long Island.

questions.questionText: What is Robert Barone's occupation in Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: Brad Garrett is 6'8" tall. The height difference between him and Ray Romano became a recurring visual gag throughout the series.

questions.questionText: What did Ray Romano want to change about Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: Romano hated the title so much that producers promised to change it if it reached the Top 10. When it did, they refused.

questions.questionText: In what Long Island town do the Barones live in Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: Lynbrook, New York is a real town. After the show aired, locals reported tourists driving by trying to find the Barone house.

questions.questionText: Who plays the overbearing mother Marie Barone in Everybody Loves Raymond?
questions.funFact: Doris Roberts won four Emmy Awards for playing Marie. She once said fans would approach her in grocery stores to complain about her character.

questions.questionText: What delivery company does Doug Heffernan work for in King of Queens?
questions.funFact: IPS was a fictional stand-in for UPS. Kevin James actually rode along with real UPS drivers to prepare for the role.

questions.questionText: Why does Arthur Spooner move in with Doug and Carrie in King of Queens?
options: He accidentally burned down his house
He retired and couldn't afford rent
questions.funFact: Arthur burned down his own uninsured home in the pilot episode. Jerry Stiller played him with the same manic energy as Frank Costanza on Seinfeld.

questions.questionText: In what New York City borough do the Heffernans live in King of Queens?
questions.funFact: The show is set in Rego Park, Queens, but was filmed entirely at Sony Pictures Studios in Culver City, California.

questions.questionText: Who plays Arthur Spooner on King of Queens?
questions.funFact: Jerry Stiller played Arthur Spooner concurrently with occasional appearances as Frank Costanza on Seinfeld — two iconic TV fathers at once.

questions.questionText: What is Carrie Heffernan's job in King of Queens?
questions.funFact: Leah Remini and Kevin James became close friends during filming. Their real chemistry is why the Doug-Carrie dynamic felt so authentic.

questions.questionText: Which comedian plays Doug's friend Spence Olchin on King of Queens?
questions.funFact: Patton Oswalt was a working stand-up comedian throughout the show's run. He'd often perform at comedy clubs on nights they weren't filming.

questions.questionText: What real-life relationship do Kevin James and Gary Valentine (who plays Danny) share on King of Queens?
questions.funFact: Gary Valentine is Kevin James's older brother by 4 years. On the show, Danny is Doug's cousin — they downplayed the real sibling connection.

questions.questionText: In what city is Full House set?
questions.funFact: The iconic painted ladies Victorian houses shown in the opening credits are real San Francisco landmarks on Steiner Street.

questions.questionText: What is Danny Tanner's job on Full House?
options: Co-host of Wake Up, San Francisco
questions.funFact: Danny started as a sports anchor before becoming co-host. Bob Saget's real personality was famously the polar opposite of the squeaky-clean Danny.

questions.questionText: What is Uncle Jesse's last name in Full House?
questions.funFact: Jesse's last name was originally 'Cochran' in the pilot. It was changed to 'Katsopolis' to match John Stamos's Greek heritage.

questions.questionText: Which twins played Michelle Tanner on Full House?
questions.funFact: Producers credited them as 'Mary Kate Ashley Olsen' (one name) so audiences wouldn't know Michelle was played by twins.

questions.questionText: What catchphrase is Stephanie Tanner known for on Full House?
questions.funFact: 'How rude!' first appeared in season 1, episode 8. Jodie Sweetin was only 5 years old and delivered it so perfectly it stuck for the whole series.

questions.questionText: What is Joey Gladstone's dream career on Full House?
questions.funFact: Dave Coulier was a real stand-up comedian before Full House. Alanis Morissette's 'You Oughta Know' is rumored to be about their real relationship.

questions.questionText: What is the name of the Full House sequel series that premiered on Netflix?
questions.funFact: Fuller House ran for 5 seasons on Netflix. Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen were the only original cast members who didn't return.

questions.questionText: What is Uncle Jesse's catchphrase on Full House?
questions.funFact: John Stamos ad-libbed 'Have mercy!' during an early taping. The audience loved it so much the writers made it Jesse's permanent catchphrase.

questions.questionText: What is Jesse Katsopolis's relationship to the Tanner family in Full House?
questions.funFact: Jesse is the brother of Danny's deceased wife Pam. He moved in to help raise the girls, making him both uncle and surrogate parent.
